factoryData.readme:
# References (from competition)

Curated, **design-facing** views of competitor best-practice flows — the onboarding and
paywall sequences worth copying (the "97% familiar" part of the strategy).

- `onboarding/` — best-in-class onboarding flows.
- `paywall/` — best-in-class paywall layouts.

**Source of truth is `libraries/memory`** (the App-Benchmark DB). This folder holds the
*curated selections + design notes* — which patterns to reuse and why — **not** the raw
captures. Pull screens from `libraries/memory`; annotate the picks here. Don't duplicate
the captures.

localOverrides.description: Curates effective competitor onboarding, paywall, and product flows as design references while retaining their sources and intended use.
